verdict.rationale: Pipecat documents an AudioBufferProcessor for capturing user and bot audio, so developers can decide per pipeline or call whether to record. Nothing in the evidence describes consent or disclosure tooling, or any retention configuration; those would have to be built by the developer. Missing for 10: documented consent/disclosure prompts or workflows, per-call recording toggles beyond adding the processor, configurable data retention or deletion policies, independent corroboration.
